text:
alex: Heads-up — my docs PR (#4321) is failing CI preview. Vale + spellcheck on an inline snippet and md-lint complains about fenced block style. Linkcheck OK. Anyone around for a quick fix?

maria: I can take a look. Do you have the snippet pasted here? sometimes missing the language hint triggers vale for JS.

alex: Yup, here's the snippet that trips Vale and spellcheck: 
```js
// quick example
function greet() {
  // teh user name
  return `Hello ${name}`
}
```

ryan: yep, that `teh` will trigger spellcheck and the missing semicolon + template use might hit a Vale rule that expects complete sentences in comments.

maria: Simple fixes: add the language hint (you already have `js`), fix the typo to `the`, and add a semicolon. Also ensure the code block is separated by a blank line from preceding text (md-lint). I can push a tiny amend unless you want to. :thumbsup:

alex: please push — I'm heads-down on another ticket. If you could also trigger a preview rerun that would be awesome.

maria: Will do. Pushing patch now (tiny change). Commit message: "docs: fix inline snippet typo + semicolon in example"

maria: @ryan can you re-run the docs preview after the push? I don't have perms to trigger the rerun from the UI.

ryan: on it. /docs-ci rerun preview 4321

docs-ci-bot: Build queued for PR #4321 — running preview pipeline. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/docs/4321

leo: quick nit — the file needs a trailing newline to satisfy md-lint's final-newline rule. If it's not in the patch, CI may still fail with that single warning.

maria: good catch, adding trailing newline now.

docs-ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr/4321 — vale and spellcheck re-run started.

alex: thanks all. I'll keep an eye on the preview link. :eyes:

docs-ci-bot: All checks passed for PR #4321 (linkcheck, vale, spellcheck, md-lint). Merge queued. :white_check_mark:

ryan: LGTM. If anything flakier pops up we should consider adding a tiny unit in the docs CI to catch the fenced-block language hint earlier, but this is fine for now.

maria: Agreed. I'll make a follow-up issue to add a quick linter rule or checklist item for inline snippets.

alex: Perfect — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
